company.name: True North Engineering
company.description: A Karachi-based MEP contracting company delivering mechanical, electrical, plumbing, HVAC and firefighting systems.

services.name: HVAC Design and Installation
services.description: HVAC systems, VRF solutions, chilled water systems, ventilation and equipment installation for commercial, residential and industrial facilities.
services.recommendation: For HVAC planning, share the approximate area, building use, location, occupancy and whether the project is new construction or renovation.

services.name: Mechanical Engineering
services.description: Mechanical coordination, industrial ducting, ventilation, process piping and equipment installation.
services.recommendation: Mechanical projects benefit from a site visit, coordinated drawings, equipment schedules and a target completion date.

services.name: Electrical Systems
services.description: Power distribution, internal wiring, cabling, substations, transformers, lighting, earthing and lightning protection.
services.recommendation: For an electrical enquiry, share the building type, approximate area, expected load and whether drawings are available.

services.name: Plumbing and Firefighting
services.description: Water supply, drainage, sewage, hydrant and sprinkler systems, pump rooms, tanks, testing and commissioning.
services.recommendation: For fire or plumbing work, share the building use, floors, approximate area and any authority or consultant requirements.

faqs.answer: Yes. True North supports residential, high-rise, commercial, healthcare and industrial projects across Karachi and surrounding areas.
A quotation starts after the team reviews your project type, approximate area, location, drawings if available and desired completion date. The exact turnaround depends on the scope.
Site visits can be arranged when they help verify existing conditions, access, measurements or coordination requirements. Mention your location in the quote request.
The team is based in Karachi and can support projects across Pakistan depending on scope, schedule and site requirements.
Drawing and approval requirements depend on the project authority, consultant and licensed scope. Share the project details so the team can confirm what documentation is required.
Yes. Existing systems can be reviewed for renovation, redesign or retrofit work. Useful information includes current drawings, equipment details, site photos and the problems you want to solve.
You can browse the project profiles in the Projects section of this page. Tell me whether your project is residential, commercial, healthcare or industrial for a more relevant direction.
Do not size an AC system from floor area alone. Capacity depends on insulation, ceiling height, windows, occupancy, climate, equipment loads and ventilation.
